study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: NIMHANS cohort (India, CN/MCI/AD dMRI); TractoInferno public multi-site training dataset (healthy controls) for pretraining
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS ... cohort ... The dataset consists of neuroimaging data from 123 cognitively normal participants (CN), 89 diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and 90 with AD."; "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: II. DATA, Paragraph 1; Feng2024.pdf.md: II. DATA, Paragraph 2

answer.NIMHANS: fine-tuning on CN and inference/testing on remaining CN, MCI, AD

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TractoInferno used to pretrain ConvVAE; 50 CN from NIMHANS used to fine-tune; remaining NIMHANS CN/MCI/AD used for inference and group statistics
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset"; "Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset, randomly selected and stratified by sex and scanner, were then used to fine-tune the model for 5000 steps. At inference time, bundle profiles from the remaining CN, MCI, and AD subjects were passed through the model"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: II. DATA, Paragraph 2; Feng2024.pdf.md: III.B Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT), Paragraph 1

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Pretraining used 198 healthy subjects from TractoInferno; fine-tuning used 50 CN from NIMHANS; remaining CN used for inference only
